import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

int total=0, failures=0;
void check(String expr,num Function() f,num expected,double relative,double absolute){
 total++; try { final actual=f(); if(actual==expected)return; if(actual.isFinite && expected.isFinite && (actual-expected).abs() <= absolute+relative*expected.abs())return; failures++; print(jsonEncode({'expr':expr,'actual':'$actual','expected':'$expected'})); } catch(e){failures++;print(jsonEncode({'expr':expr,'error':'$e'}));}
}
double sampleMean(double Function(math.Random) f,int n,int seed){final r=math.Random(seed);var sum=0.0;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){sum+=f(r);}return sum/n;}
double sampleMedian(double Function(math.Random) f,int n,int seed){final r=math.Random(seed);final values=List.generate(n,(_)=>f(r))..sort();return (values[n~/2-1]+values[n~/2])/2;}
num rejects(Function f){try {f();return 0;}catch(_){return 1;}}
